questions.question: How should BK-423 (quantifiers owe an enumeration at writing time, like figures under principle 9) be decided?

options.label: Adopt it (Recommended)
options.description: Extend principle 9 to 'every/all/never' in CLAUDE.md and the process docs. Small PR, needs a recorded process-budget raise (or a cut elsewhere). Run B's scope findings back it.

options.label: Decide against
options.description: Move BK-423 to BACKLOG-DONE as decided-against, keeping /fix-pr's after-the-finding quantifier rule. No process growth.

options.label: Defer to next measured run
options.description: Leave BK-423 open until one or two more /ship deliveries are measured; BK-418 then stays [~] too.

questions.question: Once BK-423 is decided, how should BK-418 be closed?

options.label: Close with research as outcome (Recommended)
options.description: Move BK-418 to BACKLOG-DONE pointing at research-token-spend-means.md; future measured deliveries become their own item if wanted.

options.label: Keep open for more runs
options.description: Leave [~] until the next 1-2 /ship deliveries are measured the same way (step 6 in UNDERSTANDING).

questions.question: Which new piece of work should come first after the close-out?

options.label: Handoff as review contract (Recommended)
options.description: Proposal 9: handoff lists platforms, edge cases, not-reached rows; review covers or waives each. Targets the two regressions run B missed. Needs a new backlog item first.

options.label: BK-424 token-kit phase dating
options.description: Date phases from PR creation and plan approval so the next measured run needs no hand corrections. Small, tooling-only.

options.label: Smaller reviewer input
options.description: Test cutting the ~53k-token prefix each review subagent pays (35% of run B units). Experimental, larger.

questions.question: What should happen to the sandbox notes and the stale memory?

options.label: Update both now (Recommended)
options.description: Rewrite HANDOFF.md/UNDERSTANDING.md to record that the close-out is done and the next order, and trim the BUG-280 memory to a pointer.

options.label: Archive the sandbox
options.description: Mark token-kit as finished (README pointing to the repo record); keep runs/ and prep_classes.json for BK-420, drop the working notes from active use.

options.label: Leave as is
options.description: No changes to sandbox notes or memory.

questions.question: Where should the BK-423 decision be recorded?

options.label: Principle 9 + done entry (Recommended)
options.description: Extend CLAUDE.md principle 9 and point its 'Measured failure modes' at ADR-0037 plus report § 5; the BACKLOG-DONE entry carries the evidence. No new ADR, smallest change.
options.preview:
9. **A figure or a universal claim names its derivation**:
   a number, a count, a claim about an action you took, or an
   "every", "all" or "never" — in a spec, ADR, ... review reply —
   states the command, query, or enumeration it came from, and
   that derivation is **run before the sentence is written** ...
   Measured failure modes: ADR-0037; for quantifiers,
   report § 5 (SCOPE findings).

options.label: New ADR amending ADR-0037
options.description: ADR-0044 amends ADR-0037's second decision to cover quantifiers, with its own reversal condition. More durable rationale, more text to write and review.

questions.question: Principle 9 grows by roughly 150 bytes, and CLAUDE.md is in the process budget (295,438 of 295,438 bytes). How should that be paid for?

options.label: Cut elsewhere (Recommended)
options.description: Offset the growth by tightening /fix-pr's quantifier rule, whose 'why' moves to principle 9, keeping the total flat with no raise recorded.

options.label: Record a raise
options.description: python scripts/check_process_budget.py --raise --item BK-423; /fix-pr stays as is.
